code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂, high chloride). Red cell indices are within normal limits except for elevated RDW. These findings may suggest an acute or chronic inflammatory or infectious process, possible bone marrow involvement, or hypoxemic respiratory condition. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
